text:
Marta L.: heads-up — seeing a regression on dedicated pool: structured-output + function calls frequently hit stop tokens mid-decode and cause tiny batches (1-3) + kernel swap thrash. flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/flame/sr-1989012345 :thinking_face:
Cheng T.: can you share a minimal repro and the trace? curious if it's a queue policy edge or kv eviction timing
Marta L.: repro attached (short script). quick profile snippet from the run:
```
# decode profiler
time in decode loop: 1.9s
kernel swap count: 78 (baseline 12)
batch formation: median 2, 95p 4
kv cache evictions during pause-resume: +34%
```
infra-bot: perf-alert: kernel_swap_count increased >3x for shard c3 between 2026-03-10T03:10 and 2026-03-10T03:40
Alex P.: my guess: request gets paused for tool call -> remains pinned to batch boundary -> next resumed request often has very different sequence length/hardware path -> runtime chooses different kernel -> swap thrash. two levers: (1) avoid cross-kernel batching for requests expected to pause, (2) reduce token_budget for tool_expected requests so they finish faster
Ryan S.: +1. also KV behavior: pause/resume currently drops readiness for cached KV pages and we evict to free space when low mem. prefetching on resume might amortize the hit
Marta L.: propose experiment config (canary):
```
{
  "batching": {
    "batch_keys": ["model","quant","tool_hint"],
    "prefer_affine_batches": true,
    "token_budget_overrides": {"tool_hint": 32}
  },
  "kv": {
    "prefetch_on_tool_resume": true,
    "prefetch_count": 3
  }
}
```
Cheng T.: also recommend a kernel-selection tweak: if tool_hint==true and expected_stop_prob>0.25, force kernel_family=A (prefork) to avoid runtime swap. we can gate behind a feature flag
Alex P.: can we add a cheap estimator for expected_stop_prob from prompt heuristics (stop tokens, structured-output schema presence)? should be low-cost and run pre-queue
Marta L.: yes — I'll add a small heuristic: if prompt contains explicit stop tokens or schema keys like "tool_call"/"structured_output" increment expected_stop_prob. will attach the heuristic patch to the canary
Ryan S.: I'll wire up dashboard cells: batch_size_p50, kernel_swap_count, kv_eviction_rate, tail_latency_p99, tool_pause_rate. correlate with trace id sr-1989012345
Marta L.: scheduling canary on pool c3 now with 5% traffic. will report results in ~2h. thanks all :rocket:
